earnings.title: Natera Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Generated total revenues of $794.0 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $592.2 million in the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 34.1%.
Total revenues were $794.0 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $592.2 million in the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 34.1%.
Generated a gross margin 1 of 64.7% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to a gross margin 1 of 64.9% in the third quarter of 2025.
Gross profit 1 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was $513.5 million and $384.4 million, respectively, representing a gross margin 1 of 64.7% and 64.9%, respectively.

Changes in estimates for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 increased revenue and, as a result, increased gross margin 1 by 1.5% and 3.6%, respectively, and increased gross profit 1 by $32.3 million and $55.1 million, respectively.
outlook: Raised 2026 annual revenue guidance by $140 million at the midpoint, from $2.850 billion - $2.910 billion to $3.005 billion - $3.035 billion.
